title: terraform: refactor private deployment modules for GPU node pools, IAM roles, networking and state layout
author: Sofia Martinez
description:
Motivation: private deployments require predictable, secure and cost-effective GPU capacity. Existing terraform modules had grown organically and made it difficult to (1) pin GPU machine types and autoscaling behavior across cloud providers, (2) manage IAM roles for node pools and service accounts, (3) reliably provision VPC/subnet/networking for private clusters, and (4) migrate existing state layouts to a more modular remote-state layout. This PR refactors the private terraform modules into clear, composable submodules and introduces a new state layout/migration helper.

Summary of changes: - Added modules/gpu_node_pool: new module to centralize GPU node pool configs (machine_type, gpu_count, taints, node_labels, spot/preemptible support, autoscaler settings). - Reworked modules/iam into modules/iam/roles.tf and modules/iam/policies.tf with granular role creation and optional role attachment for node pools and service accounts. - Rewrote modules/networking/vpc.tf to support explicit private subnets, route table controls, and optional shared VPCs. - Introduced modules/state/remote_state.tf and examples/state-migration to standardize locking (dynamo/consul) and tiered state files (networking, cluster, nodepools). - Example usage: examples/private-deploy/README.md plus an example trajectory for migrating an existing workspace to the new layout. - Tests: added terratest integration (tests/terraform/private-gpu) and unit validations (pre-commit tfvalidate).

Backward compatibility & migration notes: - The modules expose compatibility flags: legacy_state_layout=true|false. When set to true the modules will continue to read the old single-state workspace layout; migration instructions are included in examples/state-migration/README.md. - A provided script examples/state-migration/transfer_state.sh demonstrates exporting resources from a legacy workspace and importing into the modular state. - Customers using Dedicated/Private should plan for a short maintenance window during state migration. The PR includes a rollback plan that reattaches the old state if migration steps fail.

Testing & validation: - Ran terratest suite against a dry-run GCP project and AWS test account (short-running cluster with 1 GPU node) and verified nodepools come up with correct taints/labels and kubelet role bindings. - CI: initial run failed due to linter tfsec warnings on iam policies; addressed policy scoping and re-ran. Consolidated acceptance matrix in examples/private-deploy/test-matrix.md.

Rollout plan: - Merge to main guarded by a feature flag in platform bootstrap (opt-in). - Notify SRE and customer success for scheduled migrations. - Monitor infra-canary dashboards for nodepool scale events and RBAC audit logs for role binding anomalies.

Related: ENG-4187, SUP-1348, and previous terraform PRs pr-18345 / pr-18721 (state layout experiments).
